description_en: Retrieves service summary information based on a view code
description_zh: 根据视图code获取服务摘要信息
kebab_example: aliyun scsp query-service-config --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --view-code serviceContextViewChatStand --parameters '{"memberId":64007246863,"channelType":2,"channelId":"3a184074ee34426795f3986d306b2689"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryServiceConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The view code. Valid values:
serviceContextViewChatStand: online service
serviceContextViewHotlineStand: hotline service
parameters.help_zh:
视图编码，有以下枚举：
在线：serviceContextViewChatStand
热线：serviceContextViewHotlineStand
parameters.name: view_code

parameters.help_en: The supplementary parameters. The value is a JSON string
parameters.name: parameters

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace the cause of an error
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于跟踪错误原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful
